name: 记忆星云 · WorkBuddy 本地记忆
name_zh: 记忆星云 · WorkBuddy 本地记忆
description: Zero-dependency local memory for WorkBuddy: cross-session recall, import your WorkBuddy history, offline and private.
description_zh: 给 WorkBuddy 装上跨会话的本地记忆：零依赖、纯本地、断网可用，可一键导入 WorkBuddy 历史会话。数据不出本机、不花 Token。
description_en: Add cross-session local memory to WorkBuddy: zero-dependency, fully offline, imports your WorkBuddy history. Data stays on your machine, no API keys, no token cost.
examples_zh: 我上次让你记的那个偏好是什么？
导入我最近 90 天的 WorkBuddy 历史会话，然后记住我的偏好
之前排查桌面语音卡顿的结论是什么？
examples_en: What was the preference I asked you to remember last time?
Import my WorkBuddy sessions from the last 90 days and remember my preferences
What was the conclusion from the earlier desktop audio stutter investigation?
_comment: auth_mode omitted on purpose: this is a fully local MCP with no authentication (per official docs, omit auth_mode for no-auth servers).
